title: Chapter 98 — Research and Intelligence Workflows
intro: Product research, account intelligence, and grounding.

sections.title: AI as Research Partner
sections.content:
Use AI to research products, compare specifications, analyze competitor offerings, and gather account intelligence. A ten-minute AI research session can replace an hour of manual searching.

Ground everything in verified sources. AI can generate plausible-sounding information that is wrong. Verify critical facts — especially pricing, availability, and specifications — against primary sources.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating research workflows, ask:

Is the salesperson using AI for product and account research — or relying only on memory?
Are they verifying AI-generated information against primary sources?
Is research time being reduced while quality is maintained?
